name: co.patchfirst/patchfirst
title: Patchfirst
description: Exploited CVEs ranked by what to patch first, with CISA KEV, EPSS and ATT&CK evidence.

tools.name: get_vulnerability
tools.description: Full Patchfirst record for one CVE: description, CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV status, the ATT&CK techniques attackers use with it (each with provenance badge, basis, evidence quotes and report links), threat reports that name it, and the priority score with its factors. Every field carries provenance and a source URL.

tools.name: techniques_for_cve
tools.description: What attackers do with a CVE: its MITRE ATT&CK techniques grouped by tactic in kill-chain order (Reconnaissance -> Impact). Each technique lists every supporting link with provenance badge, basis, evidence quote and report URL, strongest provenance first.

tools.name: cves_for_technique
tools.description: Reverse ATT&CK lookup: which CVEs lead to a given technique, e.g. "which exploited CVEs give T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application?". Sorted by Patchfirst priority. Parent ids include sub-techniques (T1059 matches T1059.004). Each hit shows the link's provenance badge and best evidence quote.

kev_only.description: Only CVEs in CISA KEV (known exploited). Default false.

include_subtechniques.description: For a parent id, also match its sub-techniques. Default true.

tools.name: list_exploited
tools.description: Top known-exploited CVEs (CISA KEV) ranked by Patchfirst priority, optionally filtered to known ransomware use, an ATT&CK tactic (e.g. "initial-access", "Privilege Escalation", "TA0004") or a technique id. Each result lists its techniques with provenance badges.

ransomware_only.description: Only KEV entries with known ransomware campaign use.

tactic.description: ATT&CK tactic id, name or TA id. One of: reconnaissance, resource-development, initial-access, execution, persistence, privilege-escalation, defense-evasion, stealth, defense-impairment, credential-access, discovery, lateral-movement, collection, command-and-control, exfiltration, impact

technique.description: ATT&CK technique id, e.g. "T1190"; parent ids include sub-techniques.

tools.name: list_feed
tools.description: Newest CVEs by published date, with KEV/EPSS/CVSS (source data) and priority. Complete for the last 30 days (every CVE published in that window is core tier); older dates list core-tier CVEs only. Filter by a since-date and minimum CVSS severity.

since.description: Only CVEs published on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: check_stack
tools.description: Check a list of packages for known vulnerabilities via OSV.dev, then join with Patchfirst exploitation data (CISA KEV, EPSS, priority, ATT&CK techniques). Results are sorted exploited-first so you fix what attackers actually use. Ecosystems use OSV names: npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, crates.io, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist, Debian, Alpine, etc.

version.description: Installed version. Omit to list all known vulns for the package.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search every published CVE (all tiers) by CVE id (full or partial, e.g. "CVE-2024-3400", "2024-34"), vendor, product or title words (e.g. "fortinet fortios", "confluence", "sql injection"). Ranked by match quality, then priority.

query.description: CVE id, vendor, product or title words
